report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: gateway logs show /v1/checkout and /v1/orders returning 200, gateway metrics show 0 checkout 502s and p95 ~98ms, and order logs show successful postgres/payment/inventory calls. The only deployment record is a baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, which cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No evidence substantiates checkout errors or a faulty deployment, so hand off for more data.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs or 5xx responses from checkout/order during the incident window to confirm checkout errors actually occur
Gateway metrics showing nonzero /v1/checkout 502/5xx counts or elevated error rate
Deployment records for gateway/checkout/payment/inventory services (only order baseline v1.0.0 present)
Timeline correlating any error onset with a deployment event
